additional_context: Emma is our first child. She started walking at 11 months and has been saying a few words like 'mama', 'dada', 'ball', and 'more'. She loves playing with her older cousins and is very social at daycare. She's always been curious and loves exploring new toys.

1_point_follow.detail: She always looks where I point. If I point at a bird outside, she gets excited and looks right at it.

2_deaf_concern.detail: No, never. She responds to her name and reacts to sounds immediately.

3_pretend_play.detail: Oh yes! She loves pretending to feed her baby doll and has tea parties with her stuffed animals.

4_climbing.detail: Definitely - she climbs on everything! The couch, chairs, playground equipment. We have to watch her constantly.

5_finger_movements.detail: No, I haven't noticed anything like that.

6_point_request.detail: Yes, she points at things she wants - snacks, toys, her cup when she's thirsty.

7_point_share.detail: All the time! She points at dogs, airplanes, anything interesting and looks at me to make sure I see it too.

8_interest_children.detail: She loves other kids. At daycare, she's always excited to see her friends and tries to play with them.

9_showing_objects.detail: Yes, she brings me her toys and books all the time. She loves showing me things.

10_response_name.detail: Yes, she usually looks up right away when I call her name.

11_social_smile.detail: Absolutely! She has the biggest smile and always smiles back when we smile at her.

12_noise_sensitivity.detail: No, she's pretty easygoing with noises. The vacuum doesn't bother her at all.

13_walking.detail: Yes, she's been walking since 11 months. Now she's running everywhere!

14_eye_contact.detail: Yes, she makes good eye contact, especially when we're playing or reading together.

15_imitation.detail: She copies everything we do! Clapping, waving, even trying to sweep with a broom.

16_gaze_follow.detail: Yes, if I look at something, she follows my gaze to see what I'm looking at.

17_attention_seeking.detail: Oh yes, she loves showing off. She'll do something and then look at us to make sure we're watching.

18_understanding.detail: Yes, she understands simple things like 'get your shoes' or 'time for bath'.

19_social_referencing.detail: Yes, when something new happens, she looks at me like she's checking if it's okay.

20_movement_activities.detail: She loves being swung and bounced! She giggles and asks for more.
